name: Newsroom AI Assistant
author: koskar22

sections.description:
WordPress is now a newsroom operating system.

Welcome to Newsroom AI Assistant (by newsos.io). We transform your standard WordPress editor into a complete newsroom command center. Discover what matters in real-time, connect stories automatically, build God-Tier E-E-A-T signals, and publish faster.

⚡ Built & tested on real high-traffic news websites. Designed for real editorial teams, acting as the perfect complement to your existing SEO ecosystem (Yoast / Rank Math).

🔥 What’s inside the Newsroom OS?

1. Newsroom Command Center (Dashboard)
Plan, assign, and execute your content strategy from one central hub.
* Editorial Tasks: Assign stories to journalists with specific deadlines, recurrence, and “lead days” urgency warnings.
* Competitor Watch: Monitor your competitors’ RSS feeds directly in your dashboard.
* Actionable SEO Monitor: Instantly detects and lists articles from the past 30 days missing meta descriptions in Yoast/Rank Math. Click to filter the posts list immediately.
* Google Core Update Alerts: Live connection to Google’s Search Status API to warn you about active algorithm updates.
* Bulk Holidays Import: Import regional events and holidays via JSON directly into your editorial calendar.

2. Story Cluster Engine (Automatic Timelines)
Turn every article into an SEO content hub.
* Automatically generate a vertical story timeline based on the article’s tags or keywords.
* Smart Tag Selection: Automatically selects the most relevant topic (tag) to build the timeline, ignoring overly broad or empty tags.
* Zero DB Load: Powered by WordPress Transients caching for lightning-fast delivery.
* Custom Timeline Heading: Fully localizable with dynamic {tag} placeholder support (e.g., “History of {tag} so far:”).

3. Smart Internal Linking & Zero-Latency Navigation
* Insert relevant “Read Also” clusters in seconds using a smart checkbox search inside the editor.
* Speculation Rules API Integration: Automatically prefetches internal links and timeline URLs when the user hovers over them, resulting in zero-latency (instant) page loads and bfcache compatibility.

4. Trend Radar (No Algorithmic Bias)
See what the world is searching and publishing in real-time right inside the post editor sidebar.
* Live Google Trends: What people are searching right now.
* Unfiltered Google News: What publishers are actually writing.
* Source Badges: Beautiful, dynamic color-coded badges for your competitors’ RSS feeds.

5. God-Tier E-E-A-T Schema Engine
Output pristine JSON-LD without lifting a finger.
* Outputs NewsArticle or Article structured data.
* Dynamic Person entity generation mapping authors to their LinkedIn, Twitter, Alumni, and exact Job Titles.
* Wikidata Integration (True Semantic SEO): Map your post tags to Wikidata URLs to establish true Topic Authority.

6. AI Assistant Prompts
Built-in, perfectly engineered prompts ready to be copied to your favorite AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for SEO headlines, article structures, and meta data generation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/newsroom-ai-assistant directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. You will be automatically redirected to the Newsroom OS Setup Wizard. Follow the 4 simple steps to configure your site’s niche, schema preferences, and timeline injection mode.
  4. Navigate to the new “Newsroom OS” menu to access your Command Center.
  5. Open any post to see the new Newsroom OS sidebar in action!
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • 🧠 Smart Timeline Logic: The Story Timeline Engine now intelligently scans all article tags and automatically selects the most relevant topic to build the timeline.
  • 🎨 Source Badges: Added beautiful, dynamic color-coded badges for publishers in the Competitor Watch RSS feed.
  • ⚡ Cache Optimization: Timeline transients now automatically flush whenever an editor updates or publishes a new post.
  • 🛠️ Stability & Bug Fixes: Fixed AJAX 400 Bad Request issues in the editor sidebar, restored the internal linking search engine, and applied strict function-exists checks to completely prevent PHP Fatal Errors in restrictive hosting environments.

1.3.0

  • 🚀 Major UI Overhaul: Introduced the Enterprise Editorial Control Dashboard.
  • 🚨 Google Core Updates: Live connection to Google’s Search Status API to warn editors.
  • 🕵️ Competitor Watch: Direct RSS feed monitoring inside the Dashboard.
  • ⚡ Performance Fixes: Solved DB query bottlenecks in Schema generation and browser CPU lag in the Editor.

1.2.1

  • 🛠️ Hotfix: Restored full list of supported countries in Target Geo settings.

1.2.0

  • 🚀 Major Performance Update: Integrated the Speculation Rules API for zero-latency instant page loading (bfcache friendly).
  • 🧠 God-Tier Schema Engine: Added dynamic E-E-A-T Person entities, Wikidata mapping for tags, and VideoObject extraction. Select seamlessly between NewsArticle and Article output.
  • 📊 Actionable SEO Dashboard: Added a dynamic filter in the Command Center that scans and highlights articles missing Yoast/Rank Math descriptions.
  • ⚡ Story Clusters Refined: Complete overhaul of the Timeline Engine with Enterprise Caching (Transients) and {tag} placeholder support for fully custom headings.
  • 🛡️ Safe Uninstall Guarantee: Timeline is now dynamically injected via the_content filter (with a Manual Shortcode option).
  • 🧑‍💻 Author E-E-A-T Profiles: Added dedicated profile fields for Journalists (Job Title, Alumni, Wikidata expertise, Social URLs).
  • 🔔 Smart Editor Sidebar: Journalists now see their personal “Urgent Tasks” directly inside the Gutenberg/Classic editor sidebar based on “Lead Days”.
  • ➕ Bulk Actions: Added capability to import regional holidays/events directly into the Editorial Tasks calendar via JSON.
  • 🐛 Bug Fixes: Tested up to WordPress 6.9.4. Fixed CSS Grid layout issues in the admin area, improved Google Preview fallback logic, and resolved PHP notices.

1.1.0

  • Initial Public Architecture Release (Trend Radar, Command Center, Tasks).
